modules.title: 一张旅行计划需求单怎样变成可核对的完成结果

items.title: 条件要说出用户能看见的结果
items.text: “保存后显示行程卡”“刷新后仍保留”“日期错误时说明如何修改”都能在页面上检查。只写“体验好”或“功能正常”无法让两个人得到同一个结论。

items.title: 验收标准在开发前就能对齐范围
items.text: 先让 AI Agent 按条件实现，再在完成后逐条操作和记录结果。这样新增功能、修复问题和交付给他人时，都有同一份完成依据。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 验收标准不是技术实现清单，也不是测试覆盖率目标。它关注交付给用户的结果；单元测试、代码审查和性能检查仍可证明另外的风险是否被控制。

lessonPractice.title: 团队说“行程功能做好了”，但还没有操作过页面。下面哪一条最适合作为验收标准？

options.label: 保存有效行程后显示行程卡；刷新后同一行程仍在；日期错误时提示怎样修改
options.feedback: 对。每一项都有明确操作和可观察结果，可以直接判定通过或不通过。

options.label: 使用最新框架、覆盖率达到 80%、代码文件足够整洁
options.feedback: 这些可能有价值，但没有说明用户是否完成了保存行程这件事。

options.label: 页面看起来专业，大家感觉应该可以上线
options.feedback: 感觉不能替代可重复的检查条件。

en.title: The team says the itinerary feature is done but nobody has operated the page. Which is the best acceptance criterion?

options.label: Saving a valid itinerary shows its card, it remains after refresh, and invalid dates explain how to fix them
options.feedback: Correct. Every item has an action and an observable result, so it can pass or fail.

options.label: Use the latest framework, reach 80% coverage, and keep files tidy
options.feedback: These can matter, but they do not say whether a person can save an itinerary.

options.label: The page looks professional and everyone feels it can ship
options.feedback: A feeling cannot replace repeatable conditions.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请按这三条验收标准完成行程保存：保存后出现行程卡，刷新后内容还在，日期不合法时告诉用户怎么改。改完后逐条操作验证，并把每条的结果告诉我。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Implement itinerary saving against these three acceptance criteria: show an itinerary card after save, keep it after refresh, and tell people how to fix invalid dates. Then operate each case and report the result for every criterion.

learning.assumes: You have made a page or feature for someone else to use.
learning.outcome: You can turn a vague request into user results that can individually pass or fail.

modules.title: How an itinerary request becomes checkable completion

items.title: State a result a person can see
items.text: “Show an itinerary card after save,” “keep it after refresh,” and “explain an invalid date” can all be checked in the page. “Good experience” and “works normally” cannot.

items.title: Align scope before building
items.text: Ask an AI Agent to implement against the conditions, then operate and record each result. The same completion basis works for features, fixes, and handoff.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: Acceptance criteria are not an implementation checklist or a coverage target. They focus on the delivered user result; unit tests, review, and performance checks still address other risks.

distinctions.label: Test case
distinctions.text: {c:acceptance-criteria} state what a result must satisfy. A {c:test-case} states the setup, steps, input, and expected result used to check one condition.
